import numpy as np
G=np.full((30,30),4,dtype=int)
G[:9,6]=3; G[8,:7]=3
G[:23,21]=3
G[13,14:22]=3; G[13:23,14]=3
G[22,:]=3
G[23:,21]=3
marks={(6,4):1,(7,5):8,(14,15):1,(15,16):9,(19,11):1,(20,12):8,(21,13):6,(19,24):6,(20,23):5,(21,22):1,(23,20):7,(24,19):2,(25,18):6,(23,29):6,(24,28):5}
for (r,c),v in marks.items():G[r,c]=v
# label non-wall components
from collections import deque,defaultdict
labels=np.full((30,30),-1,int); comps=[]
for r in range(30):
 for c in range(30):
  if G[r,c]==3 or labels[r,c]>=0:continue
  k=len(comps); q=deque([(r,c)]); labels[r,c]=k; pts=[]
  while q:
   x,y=q.popleft();pts.append((x,y))
   for nx,ny in ((x+1,y),(x-1,y),(x,y+1),(x,y-1)):
    if 0<=nx<30 and 0<=ny<30 and G[nx,ny]!=3 and labels[nx,ny]<0:
     labels[nx,ny]=k;q.append((nx,ny))
  comps.append(pts)
for k,pts in enumerate(comps):
 print('comp',k,'size',len(pts),'bbox',min(x for x,y in pts),max(x for x,y in pts),min(y for x,y in pts),max(y for x,y in pts),'marks',[(p,G[p]) for p in pts if G[p] not in (3,4)])
